tool.name: get_session_cost
tool.title: Get session cost
tool.description: Explains what one session cost and why: token totals (uncached input, cache write, cache read, reasoning, output) and AI Credits, each with turn coverage; cache hit ratio; spend per model; the most expensive turns; cost-relevant events (compaction, cache expiry, model switch, ...); and context overhead (system-prompt parts, tools defined but never used); the session's repository and project. null means unknown, never zero — see unavailableReasons. Cost figures carry their basis: billed (what GitHub Copilot billed, AI Credits), reported (what the agent logged itself, USD) and priced (tokens × the price version in force on the turn's channel at the turn's time; see get_price_book, and priceVersionIds). The preferred figure is billed, else reported, else priced. A priced figure with apiEquivalent: true is what the same use costs on the API, though a flat-fee plan may have covered it. An unknown figure is {known:false, reason}, never 0; totals give knownTurns of turns per basis. Currencies stay apart; `usd` converts only at 1 AI Credit = $0.01.

provider.description: Log provider id, e.g. "claude-code", "vscode", "pi-agent", "mitmproxy" (see list_log_providers). Defaults to the provider active in the web app.

topTurns.description: How many of the most expensive turns to return (default 5).
